nodes.label: Coding Behavior Contract (13 Rules)
nodes.rationale: Core operating rules for any Claude session/subagent working in this repo: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution, no non-language work in the model, hard token budgets, surface conflicts, read before write, tests check behavior, checkpoint long operations, convention beats novelty, fail visibly, expand mental model rather than redirect action.

nodes.label: Eventar → CPD Platform Pivot (2026-07-03)
nodes.rationale: Eventar pivoted from an internal workshop manager to a CPD/CME/CE event + credit platform for regulated professions, HK launch with HKCP as first accrediting body. Backend-first roadmap; frontend frozen until Milestone-M2 review.

nodes.label: Audit insert last (pivot-era hard rule)
nodes.rationale: Any transaction writing audit_events emits the audit event as the LAST statement before commit; the chain trigger holds pg_advisory_xact_lock until commit — prevents ordering/race issues in the audit hash chain.

nodes.label: Measurement vs inference (automation rule)
nodes.rationale: Automation acts only on deterministic measurements (rate limits, Turnstile, OTP failure counts); inference signals produce flags for humans, never automatic action. No IP-level enforcement on authenticated routes.

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy rule (organisation_id + RLS)
nodes.rationale: Every new domain table carries organisation_id + RLS; Q20 reversed the old single-org decision 6.3.

nodes.label: Frontend freeze rule
nodes.rationale: While frontend freeze holds: only backend, migrations, Server Actions, and tests are in scope; no new surfaces or restyles.

nodes.label: Hard rules (never break)
nodes.rationale: Staff identity keyed on email not auth.users.id; email_log inserted before send; requireStaff() at top of every staff Server Action (proxy.ts in Next 16, not middleware.ts); service-role key only in lib/supabase/admin.ts with server-only; RLS enabled on every table; single main branch; no premature external services; three-layer validation; three-layer auth; no PII in logs.

nodes.label: Pre-deploy gates — ALL CLOSED
nodes.rationale: Four pre-public-deploy gates resolved: PII enumeration oracle fixed on /checkin/confirm, CSPRNG registration codes via crypto.randomInt(), host-header spoofing fixed via lib/origin.ts, migration history drift reconciled 26/26.
